description: This Java class, DesktopSessionService, provides service-layer operations for managing desktop sessions, including CRUD operations and conversions between entities and DTOs.

classes.name: DesktopSessionService
classes.description: Service class managing desktop sessions, including retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting sessions, with exception handling for not found cases.

methods.name: getAllSessions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all desktop session DTOs.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Fetches a specific desktop session DTO by its ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new desktop session based on the provided request DTO.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates the name of an existing desktop session identified by ID.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Deletes a desktop session by ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: toDto
methods.description: Converts a DesktopSession entity to its DTO representation.
